digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push delivery and status reporting
propositions: A failed tickets push on the async path with sync.push=async spawns a detached Popen with stderr=DEVNULL, discarding all warning output including git rejection reasons and backlog information.

Library embedders calling rebar.comment(...) cannot observe push failures because rebar/__init__.py attaches only a NullHandler and install_stderr_handler runs only from CLI and MCP server, leaving stderr empty.

The MCP comment_ticket tool outputs only {result: ok} to the agent even when the remote pre-receive hook declines the push, because the handler targets the server's stderr which the agent never reads.
The reconciler subprocess logs under the rebar root while installing its handler on rebar_reconciler, making its pushes unobservable even in the foreground.

A durable marker mechanism in the git dir (push_state.py) records terminal push failures at the _raise_if_strict choke point and exposes status via rebar.push_status() and MCP push_status field, making failures observable on all four paths despite discarded stderr.
The marker clears on a successful push and does not perturb working-tree state, preserving the contract that failed pushes never fail the caller and always return None without raising.
